content: Pirui Purui minchuna
Jerusalem ria akahong Pharisees le Dan Oja alek Jesu kolla anhong kintup.

Ama thiemroi alek ning ankut soplei a bu anleibak kha anmani ning anleimu, hiwahi anmani senadan dungjui a akinthengmak e, tichu anmani ning ankut kha Pharisees ngaining mipuideng anminchu anga leithomuk.
(Ajarchu Pharisees le Jehudi rikip ning pi le pu ngai leiminchu senadan anleijui: ankut kha akatha ansopmak laiseng anmani ning leibak muk;
khanchu keithel ria anheichoi neinak ngaikha amasa ansop mintheng mak laiseng leibak muk.
Khale kinroi a anmani ning alak senadan akatam anleijui, tichu hai, bel, sumbel khan phenchung ngaihi anlei sop mintheng.

Khawa jarra Pharisees ngai le Dan Oja ngai ning Jesu deng anleirakal, <<Angsik jarrami nang thiemroi ngai ning eini pi le pu khanga anleida minchuna anleijui mak, takkha khawa nek a kut achok pumma anleibak?>>
Jesu ning anmanideng aleimasang,

content.text: <<Isaiah chongsaan kha kho-ongtuk akidikmi nangni jarra! Nangni akatha kinlem nin e, tia hi-anghin aleimije:
<Hiwa mingai hining anmur bei ning anakaja, Pathien ning ati,
Tak anmulung chu kei ria akalaak a an-om.
Kei anukumuk hinum anmani sik anemna ommak,
Ajarchu anmani ning miring senadan anminchu kha
Pathien Dan anga anmani ning anminchu!>
<<Nangni ning Pathien chongpe kha ninda-a khan miring ngai minchuna kha ninjui.>>

content: Khan Jesu ning atinok,

content.text: <<Ninbing a minchuna kha minsethei nasik ninsing theina khaning Pathien Dan kha kinlep nasik lampui nin-neije.
Ajarchu Moses chongpe nakhan, <Napa le nanu nakaja sik,> khan, <Napa le nanu akathamak a nirilset inchu, nangkha thina apesik e.>
Takkha nang minchunna khachu mi inkhat ning ang-mikhat apa a-imakli anu santheina anei inum, tak nang ning niti, <Hiwa hi Corban> tinachu, Pathien ta e,
Amaning anpa a-imakli annu sansik ria minsan mukchujei.
Hi-ang hin minchuna kha milak ngaideng ninmintunga Pathien chongkha ninten jei. Khana hi-ang kupo neinak alalak akatam nangni ning nintho.>>

content: Miring akimintheng mak neinak
Khan Jesu ning mipui ngaikha ama kolla akoinok a khan anmanideng aleiti,

content.text: <<Nangni rikip kachongril hi rangairu, khan jet ru.
Tol ria miring sunga alut khaning mi minchokmak. Miring sunga ria ahongkusuok khaning mi aminchok.>>

content: Amaning mipui ngaikha aleimathaanli khan inn inkhat a aleilut, ama thiemroi ngaining achongril kha minchen nasik anleirakal.
Jesu ning anmanideng aleiril,

content.text: <<Nangni milak ngainek a jetna neidet muk chu. Jetlei mo nin e? Tol ria miring sunga alut khaning amakha amintheng edet mak,
ajarchu khawa kha amulung sunga lutmak tak awon sunga akulut e, khawa so-a ataksa ria tolla ahongsuok e.>> (Jesu ning hiwa aril nahi, baksik rikip akintheng tia amalar.)

content: Khana amaning arilnok a,

content.text: <<Miring ria aheikusuok khan amakha aminchok e.
Ajarchu mi mulung sung ria, akathamak mindonna kha aheisuok a khawa khaning amakha akathamak amintho, hurna, muruk, mithatna,
mi numei-arother setpuina, phamrai kase, khan akathamak rikip akatho; wartheng kiril, ra-ot, omchen kathamak, mikirilset, kin-or, khan akapang,
Hiwa akathamak rikip ngai hi miring mulung sung ria aheisuok e khana khawa khaning ama amintheng mak e.>>

content: Nupui inkhat taksenna

Khan Jesu ning khawa mun kha amathaanli Tyre khopui kolla a ase jei. Amaning inn inkhat sunga aleilut khan khawa mun na a-om kha tute ning anjet sik leimonom mak, tak akinthup a akasot leiom tor mak je.
Asanu sunga ratha kathamak kulut nupuinu khaning Jesu chungchanga ajetli kinranga ahonga akekunga aleikinbok.
Khawa nupuinu kha Syria ram a Phoenicia ramsung a akinte Jat-lop mi inkhat e. Khawanu khaning asanu ria khori kha Jesu ning aholsut penasik aleiti.
Takkha Jesu ning aleimasang, <<Amasatak a naipang ngai wai minkhop di ri. Naipang ngai bu kha kusut a ui deng pesik chu akidik imak.>>
Khawanu ning aleimasang, <<Oja, ui ngainum naipang ngai bakbang dokhang thoi-a akata ngai kha anbak e!>>
Khawa jarra Jesu ning khawanu deng aleiti, <<Kha ang nana heimasang jarra, ni inteng kir toro, nasanu ria khori asuok kha nawamu sik jei!>>
Khawanu kha inteng akirra asanu phenchunga ajal kha awamu; khori kha asanu ria adiktabak aleisuok jei.
Jesu ning akachong theimak le akuornum kiset inkhat amindam
Khan Jesu ning Tyre ramsung kha aleimathaan a Sidon arakaan a, Decapolis (tinachu Khopui som) ramsunga aleise a khan Galilee tuitham teng aheiwa.
Miring alek ning akuor kiset, khan akatha akachong theimak mi inkhat anheiroi a, Jesu ning achunga akut adape nasik anlei ni.
Khawa jarra Jesu ning amakha mipui ngai ria abinga akoisuok a, akutchalla amichil thonna akuor sunga aleithun li, khan amalei kha aleikotok pe.
Khawa soa Jesu ning marwan chungteng a-enna, kinthuktak aphuk asanna, pasalpa denga aleiti, <<Ephphatha,>> tinachu <<Kinlong taro!>>
Khawa pha takkhan pasalpa akuor ajet je, amalei asur kha omleia chong arilsuok torjei.
Khan Jesu ning atu inkhat deng anril mak nasik mipuideng chong ape jei; tak amaning chong ape kha akikhella rilmuru atikha akakhella anlei ril jei.
Khana akajet rikip ning anleingak jei. <<Ang rikip hi kho-ongtuk a akatha atho mije!>> anti. <<Kuor kiset naknum aminjet, khan akachong theimak aminchong thei!>>

Akinje alek a chu phenchung om-mak.
